title: A commit whose KB-Work check-trailers would refuse is refused by the commit-msg hook, not only warned of
goal: kbgit.py commit-msg exits non-zero, leaving no commit, for a message whose KB-Work check-trailers refuses (a planning commit naming an item whose file it does not change), so no later step (a review's done --commit, whose evidence names the tip) builds on a commit that must be rewritten before the push. SP-vk3wf746 close: the review's parking commit named the review story in KB-Work, the hook only printed the refusal, done --commit recorded it as evidence, and the commit and the done had to be reset and run again.
